name: parallel-design-exploration
title: Parallel Design Exploration
description: Standalone Open Design scenario for parallel prototyping: render multiple full design directions side by side, preserve prior rounds, and converge only when the user asks.

query.en: Use Parallel Design Exploration for my design brief. Render {{variantCount}} materially different, fully realized sibling prototypes in the same comparative field before asking me to choose. Treat my chat prompt as the authoritative brief, preserve prior rounds, append descendants on follow-up turns, and do not recommend a winner unless I ask to converge.
query.zh-CN: 使用 Parallel Design Exploration 处理我的设计需求。先在同一个比较画布中渲染 {{variantCount}} 个实质不同、足够完整的并行方案，再让我选择。以当前聊天 Prompt 作为权威设计 brief；后续轮次保留旧方案并追加新分支；除非我明确要求收敛，否则不要推荐赢家。

exampleOutputs.title: Mobile search — three parallel interaction directions
